API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIFile Type Control PolicyFile Type Rule Resource Update Rule
File Type Rule Resource Update Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/fileTypeRules/:ruleId

Updates the File Type Control policy rule information for the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the policy rule

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The File Type Control policy rule information

id
int32

System-generated identifier for a file type policy

protocols
string[]

Protocol for the given rule. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [ANY_RULE, SMRULEF_CASCADING_ALLOWED, FOHTTP_RULE, FTP_RULE, HTTPS_RULE, HTTP_RULE]

order
int32

Order of policy execution with respect to other file type policies. Order N indicates N-th file type policy is evaluated. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

timeQuota
int32

Time quota in minutes, after which the policy must be applied. If not set, no time quota is enforced. Ignored if action is BLOCK.

sizeQuota
int32

Size quota in KB, beyond which the policy must be applied. If not set, size quota is not enforced. Ignored if action is BLOCK.

description
string

Comments provided by the administrator

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
users
object[]
urlCategories
object[]
fileTypes
string[]

This field is replaced with fileTypeCategories. Zscaler recommends updating your API configurations to use the fileTypeCategories attribute in place of fileTypes.

FTCATEGORY_AU3, FTCATEGORY_BGI, FTCATEGORY_MANIFEST, FTCATEGORY_NLS, FTCATEGORY_TLB, FTCATEGORY_ASHX, FTCATEGORY_EXP, FTCATEGORY_FLASH_VIDEO, FTCATEGORY_AVI, FTCATEGORY_MPEG, FTCATEGORY_MP4, FTCATEGORY_3GPP, FTCATEGORY_QUICKTIME_VIDEO, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_MEDIA_MOVIE, FTCATEGORY_MKV, FTCATEGORY_WEBM, FTCATEGORY_VS4, FTCATEGORY_TS]

fileTypeCategories
object[]
devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

minSize
int32

Minimum file size (in KB) used for evaluation of the FTP rule

maxSize
int32

Maximum file size (in KB) used for evaluation of the FTP rule

filteringAction
string

Action taken when traffic matches policy. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [BLOCK, CAUTION, ALLOW]

capturePCAP
boolean

Enable or disable Capture PCAP Settings

operation
string

File operation performed. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [UPLOAD, DOWNLOAD, UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD]

activeContent
boolean

Flag to check whether a file has active content or not

unscannable
boolean

Flag to check whether a file is unscannable or not

passwordProtected
boolean

A Boolean field indicating whether the rule applies to password-protected files. This criterion is used in combination with the fileTypes criterion and is applicable only to specific file types such as 7-Zip, RAR, ZIP, ZIPx, PDF, password-protected Microsoft Office files, and other password-protected and encrypted files. So, when the passwordProtected field is set to true, only the applicable file types can be specified using the fileTypes field.

Note: Traffic is evaluated against this criterion only when uploading and downloading of password-protected files is allowed at the organization level via the Security Exceptions in the Malware Protection policy.

state
string

Administrative state of the policy. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
rank
int32

Admin rank. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule was last modified. Ignored if the request is POST or PUT.

lastModifiedBy
object
accessControl
string

Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's RBA state. Ignored if the request is POST or PUT.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

name
string

Rule Name

labels
object[]
zpaAppSegments
object[]
cloudApplications
object[]
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
